mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 76 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look west over Mount Horeb at 8:21 PM, you can spot the International Space Station heading northeast toward Madison for about six minutes. Tonight will drop to a low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Verona police responded to a burglary on September 10 at Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody with a handgun. Additionally, the city has posted notices for the November general election and has ongoing engineering reports available through City Hall.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street, and look forward to yoga on September 14 and trivia starting September 15.

On September 10, officers were dispatched to a residence on Hunters Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a suspect was located and taken to a Madison hospital for treatment, facing charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
You can grab the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
